description: This file defines the interface and constants for the MediaRecorder class used in Android's media framework. It includes enums for sources, formats, encoders, states, and events, as well as class declarations for MediaRecorder and its callback interface, MediaRecorderListener. It specifies methods for configuring, controlling, and querying media recording functionality.
external_methods: status_t methods for setting sources, encoders, formats, files, parameters, etc.

classes.name: MediaRecorderListener
classes.description: Interface for callback notifications from MediaRecorder.

classes.name: MediaRecorder
classes.description: Main class for media recording, providing methods to configure, control, and query media recording sessions.

methods.description: Handles cleanup when the MediaRecorder process dies.

methods.description: Checks if the MediaRecorder is properly initialized.

methods.description: Resets the recorder to idle state.

methods.description: Releases resources associated with the recorder.
